name: vLLM 0.1.4 (EmbeddedLLM ROCm port) on amd-instinct-mi210: LLaMA2-13B 2x MI210 TP2 offline throughput tok/s
methodology: THIRD-PARTY (EmbeddedLLM vllm_rocm, Oct 2023). LLaMA2-13B 2x MI210 TP2. vLLM v0.1.4 EmbeddedLLM ROCm port; offline throughput over 1000 questions. Aggregate tok/s for the run, NOT per-request decode.
notes: Early vLLM 0.1.4 - pre-continuous-batching; lower bound vs modern vLLM. MI210 measured vs A100-80SX+L40 on identical load.
